findings.mechanism: The attributed trace joins the day-period carrier to the sight-clearing facet of the unveiling root, shifting emphasis from light added to an observer toward perception refined by the act.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader feels disclosure as sharpening the interface of seeing.
findings.containment: The sight-clearing image remains attributed and local; no literal eye paint, sword, or separate observer is asserted.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT trace is focus-anchored but legacy-unbound and medium-qualified, so perception refinement remains attributed.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Şafaktan güneş batımına kadar ışığın yayıldığı ve geceye karşıt olan süredir.
branch_activations.carrier: The day noun carries the light-opened temporal field.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The verb supplies the act by which an object becomes discernible.
branch_activations.activation: The daylight-period facet supplies the medium for the sight-clearing contact.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Daylight is the interval in which perception is made clear enough to resolve the object.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch remains daytime and does not become the watercourse or rebuke branch.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Göze çekilen belirli boya, görüşü daha berrak hale getiren madde veya uygulama olarak adlandırılır.
branch_activations.carrier: The verb carries making the feminine object discernible.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The day provides the luminous condition, and the exact trace supplies the sight-clearing relation.
branch_activations.activation: The sight-clarifying facet meets the direct disclosure frame and recasts unveiling as refinement of perception.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Daylight polishes perception until the object can be discerned.
branch_activations.boundary: The supplied facet is a perceptual image, not a claim that the historical eye-paint practice occurs.

findings.title: Unveiling as presentation
findings.claim: The object can enter visibility as something presented before an implied beholding position.
findings.mechanism: The attributed trace joins the public daylight interval to the presentation facet of the transitive unveiling verb and its feminine object.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader feels the disclosure as an event of display, not merely an ambient change in light.
findings.containment: The presentation is a local attributed resonance; no literal bride, wedding, ceremony, or social audience is asserted.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT trace is exploratory and legacy-unbound, while its focus coordinates and changed reading are complete.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Şafaktan güneş batımına kadar ışığın yayıldığı ve geceye karşıt olan süredir.
branch_activations.carrier: The day noun carries the public luminous interval.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The transitive verb and feminine object supply the event that can be presented.
branch_activations.activation: The daylight-period facet creates the visible setting for the presentation relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The object is brought into view within the public opening of day.
branch_activations.boundary: The setting is not a literal ceremony; it only activates the presentation contour.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: gelini törende gösterme veya gösterilmiş gelini görme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Gelin, düğün bağlamında hazırlanıp eşine ve ilgili topluluğa görünür biçimde sunulur.
branch_activations.carrier: The verb presents the feminine direct object into visibility.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Daylight supplies the public interval and visible field.
branch_activations.activation: The presentation facet meets the direct object and luminous interval, producing an implied beholding relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Day presents her into visibility as an event of display.
branch_activations.boundary: Only the relational display pressure survives; the branch's wedding participants and ceremony are not imported.

findings.title: Clarity by displacement
findings.claim: Daylight can clear the field by driving concealment out, giving the unveiling a subtractive contour.
findings.mechanism: The attributed trace joins the day-opening facet to the departure-or-expulsion facet of the verb, changing visibility from added light alone to removal of an obstruction.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees that making-visible may also mean making room for visibility.
findings.containment: This is attributed exploratory pressure; it does not claim a literal settlement, community, exile, or human expulsion in the ayah.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT trace is exploratory and legacy-unbound, but its focus anchors, branch coordinates, and changed reading are supplied.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin açılması, açılması için yarılması veya mevcut açıklığının genişletilmesi temel ilişkidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The day noun carries the opening interval.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The verb supplies a covered-to-visible change that needs room in the field.
branch_activations.activation: The opening facet gives the subtractive branch a cleared-space contact around the unveiling action.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Day opens the field so the object can stand exposed.
branch_activations.boundary: Only opening and widening pressure is retained from the day branch; no bodily or disputed extension is claimed.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir topluluk yerleştiği evlerden, ülkeden veya yurttan ayrılır.
branch_activations.carrier: The unveiling verb carries the removal-shaped clearing action.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The day-opening contact supplies a field from which concealment can depart.
branch_activations.activation: The departure facet meets the direct unveiling relation as an attributed subtractive image.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Day clears by making what conceals the object leave the field.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is not literal communal departure or expulsion; it supplies only the removal contour.
